values.text: a long coat of layered leaf-green silk
a high-collared mantle of gray felt pinned with a bone clasp
a sleeveless tunic of woven bark fiber over leggings
a hooded cloak dyed the blue of dusk
a fitted jerkin of stitched river-reed
a draped robe of undyed wool belted with braided cord
a shoulder cape of overlapping copper scales
a wrap of moth-gray linen tied at the hip
a stiff-collared vest of pressed lichen-cloth
a quilted riding coat with antler toggles
a gown of pale silk embroidered with vines
a short cloak of patched fox fur
